content:
**1/5 Stars - Terrible Purchase, Save Your Money**

I bought this foam mattress three months ago and deeply regret this purchase. Within the first week, it developed permanent body impressions that never bounce back, leaving me sleeping in uncomfortable divots every night. The mattress retains an incredible amount of heat, making me wake up drenched in sweat regardless of room temperature or bedding choices. Despite following all the manufacturer's instructions, it has a persistent chemical odor that gives me headaches and makes the bedroom smell like a factory. The edge support is virtually non-existent - sitting on the side causes the entire mattress to compress and nearly dump me onto the floor. My back pain has actually gotten worse since switching to this mattress, and I wake up more tired than when I went to bed. Customer service was unhelpful when I reached out about these issues, basically telling me these problems are "normal break-in period adjustments." I'm now stuck with an expensive mattress that's ruining my sleep quality and I'll have to replace it much sooner than expected.
